notes: The assignment's seven sample queries (AI_SPEC.md section 13), each bound to a seed book. 'guidance' is the assignment's expected response, quoted for the reviewer. 'checks' are case-insensitive patterns the reply must (or, with mustNot, must not) contain; the runner also checks every reply for an early acknowledgement and for fact-guard warnings. Checks are a first pass: a person reads every reply. Version .2 (2026-10-20): numbers may be written as words, and the acknowledgement check reads past an inline greeting (two false misses in the first live run).

cases.subject: No royalty yet
cases.description: I published my book 4 months ago and still haven't received any royalty. What's going on?
cases.guidance: Acknowledge the frustration. Explain the quarterly royalty cycle and 45-day payout window. Check if their bank details are linked. Provide the specific next payout date. If the payment is genuinely overdue, escalate with a 48-hour resolution timeline.

cases.subject: Royalty seems too low
cases.description: My royalty amount seems too low. I sold 200 copies but only received 3,000.
cases.guidance: Explain the net profit calculation: MRP minus printing, platform commission, and shipping. Offer to share a detailed line-by-line royalty breakdown. Don't be defensive; offer transparency.

cases.subject: Different ISBN on Amazon
cases.description: My book is showing a different ISBN on Amazon than what's on the physical copy.
cases.guidance: Treat as high priority. Acknowledge this is a serious data issue. Confirm you are escalating to the production team immediately. Provide a 48-hour resolution timeline.

cases.subject: Terrible print quality
cases.description: I received my author copies and the print quality is terrible. The images are blurry and pages are misaligned.
cases.guidance: Apologise sincerely. Ask the author to share photos of the defective copies. Confirm that BookLeaf will arrange a free reprint once verified. Provide a timeline of 5-7 business days for the reprint.

cases.subject: Currently Unavailable on Amazon
cases.description: My book is published but it's showing as "Currently Unavailable" on Amazon.
cases.guidance: Explain that this is typically a stock sync issue. Confirm you're triggering a re-sync with the distribution team. Set expectation: 24-48 hours for it to go live again.

cases.subject: Still in typesetting
cases.description: It's been 3 weeks and my book is still in typesetting. When will it be done?
cases.guidance: Check the actual production status. If it's delayed, be honest about why (e.g., waiting on author approval for proofs). Provide a specific updated timeline. Don't blame the author even if the delay is on their side; frame it collaboratively.

cases.subject: Updating my book description
cases.description: Can I update the description of my book on Amazon after it's already live?
cases.guidance: Yes, metadata updates can be submitted through the dashboard or by emailing the BookLeaf team. Changes typically reflect on platforms within 3-5 business days.
